senses.gloss:
भल् r. 1st and 10th cls. (भलते भालयते)
 1. To describe, to expound, to
explain.
 2. To see. r. 1st cl.
 1. To hurt, to injure.
 2. To give. r.
10th cl. To throw up.

भल्ल् r. 1st cl. (भल्लते)
 1. To tell, to describe.
 2. To hurt, to injure, to
wound or kill.
 3. To give.
भल्लात m. (-तः) Marking-nut plant. E. See the next.

भल्ल m. (-ल्लः)
 1. A bear.
 2. An epithet of ŚIVA.
 mn. (-ल्लः-ल्लं) A kind of
arrow.
 f. (-ल्ली)
 1. An arrow, with a crescent-shaped head.
 2. The
marking-nut plant; also भल्लातकी.
 E. भल्ल् to hurt or kill, aff. अच् ।

भाल m. (-लः)
 1. The forehead.
 2. Darkness.
 E. भल् to explain, and
अञ् aff.; a man's fortunes being supposed to be legible on his
forehead; or भा to shine, aff. लच् ।

भल्लक m. (-कः) A bear.
 E. कन् added to the preceding.

भल्लपुच्छी f. (-च्छी) A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.)
 E. भल्ल a bear,
पुच्छ a tail; to which the flower is compared.

भल्लातक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) The marking-nut plant, (Semicarpus anacardi-
um.)
 E. भल्ल an arrow, अत् to resemble, aff. घञ् with कन् added;
wounding like a weapon; also भल्लात, भल्ली, &c.

भल्लिका f. (-का) Marking-nut.
 E. कन् added to भल्ली.

भल्लुक m. (-कः) A bear.
 E. भल्ल् to hurt, aff. उक; also भल्लूक.

भल्लूक m. (-कः) A bear.
 E. भल्ल् to injure, Unādi aff. ऊक; also भाल्लुक
and भल्लुक ।

भाल्लुक m. (-कः) A bear.
 E. भल्ल् to injure, aff. उकञ् or ऊकञ्, whence
also भाल्लूक; and with उक aff. भल्लुक, भल्लूक, &c. q. v. also भालुक
and भालूक ।

भालदर्शन n. (-नं) Red lead.
 E. भाल, and दर्शन appearing; being used
to stain the forehead with particular lines, and marks.

भालदृश् m. (-दृक्) A name of ŚIVA.
 E. भाल and दृश् the eye, having the
third eye in his forehead; also similar compounds, as भाललोचन, &c.

भालाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः)
 1. A sort of fish, commonly the Rohita, (Cyprinus
[]
Rohita, HAM.)
 2. A saw.
 3. A sort of potherb.
 4. A man born with
lucky lines on his forehead.
 5. A tortoise.
 6. A name of ŚIVA. E.
भाल the forehead, and अङ्क a spot or mark.

भालु m. (-लुः) The sun.
 E. भॄ-ञुण् रस्य लः ।
